This document lists the equipment Inspection checklist I2, which
must be performed weely as indicated by W1 in the title block.

items:
The fire detection piping is
 pressurized with air.

Do not accidentally break the
 glass bulb in the detector head.

Check for correct air pressure in the water storage
 tank. 
 (min. pressure is 12 bars, max. pressure is 15 bars)

Check for correct water level in the storage tank. The
 correct level is in the middle of the sight (inspection) glass. You must
 open the two hand shut-off valves on the water level indicator. It is very
 important to close these valves after inspection.

If the water level in the storage tank is low,
 open the gate valve in the water supply line to the tank and switch on the
 tank filling pump until the water level reaches the middle of the sight
 glass.

After the filling is completed, make sure the
 gate valve in the water supply line to the tank is closed.

Check indicating lights in the control panel. Replace
 any burned lamps.

Momentarily open the drain valve on the bottom of the
 air receiver tank to discharge any accumulated water.

The suction filters must be checked and cleaned
 if required.

Check for any air leaks in the piping system,
 if any leaks are detected, isolate the system and repair leak as soon as
 possible.

Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment Inspection checklist I2, which
must be performed weely as indicated by W1 in the title block.
Safety Precautions
Work order must be issued.
The fire detection piping is
 pressurized with air.
Do not accidentally break the
 glass bulb in the detector head.
Safety helmet and safety shoes.
Work to be Carried Out
Check for correct air pressure in the water storage
 tank. 
 (min. pressure is 12 bars, max. pressure is 15 bars)
Check for correct water level in the storage tank. The
 correct level is in the middle of the sight (inspection) glass. You must
 open the two hand shut-off valves on the water level indicator. It is very
 important to close these valves after inspection.
If the water level in the storage tank is low,
 open the gate valve in the water supply line to the tank and switch on the
 tank filling pump until the water level reaches the middle of the sight
 glass.
After the filling is completed, make sure the
 gate valve in the water supply line to the tank is closed.
Check indicating lights in the control panel. Replace
 any burned lamps.
Air
 Compressor Maintenance
Momentarily open the drain valve on the bottom of the
 air receiver tank to discharge any accumulated water.
The suction filters must be checked and cleaned
 if required.
Check for any air leaks in the piping system,
 if any leaks are detected, isolate the system and repair leak as soon as
 possible.
